title: Acuivect
subtitle: Precision Insertion Demonstrator
author: Harrison B. Goldberg
status: Digital design complete; physical build deferred due to budget.

summary: A benchtop insertion demonstrator combining XYZ positioning, camera-to-tool alignment and a removable cartridge on a synthetic brain phantom.

specifications.label: Project stage
specifications.value: Digital design complete; physical build deferred due to budget.

specifications.label: Purpose
specifications.value: Benchtop probe-insertion demonstrator using a synthetic brain phantom

specifications.label: Motion platform
specifications.value: Genmitsu 3018-PRO kit with custom cartridge, dock and mounting geometry

specifications.label: Nominal modeled travel
specifications.value: X: 250 mm total; Y: 140 mm total; Z: 45 mm downward

specifications.label: Nominal phantom
specifications.value: 120 x 100 x 26 mm; synthetic test medium

specifications.label: Insertion-depth targets
specifications.value: 2, 5 and 8 mm; intended test depths, not measured results

specifications.label: Targeting architecture
specifications.value: Two USB cameras; camera-to-tool calibration and physical targeting validation pending

specifications.label: Tool handling
specifications.value: Removable seated cartridge, servo latch and table-mounted dock

specifications.label: Parametric definition
specifications.value: 21,616 editable parameters retained in the private native model

specifications.label: Mechanism graph
specifications.value: 28 joints, 19 rigid groups and 8 motion links

specifications.label: Print-oriented design
specifications.value: 69 unique printed shapes, 84 occurrences; physical prints pending

specifications.label: Materials
specifications.value: PETG custom printed parts; metal frame, guides and hardware; component materials recorded in CAD

specifications.label: Documented parts estimate
specifications.value: $489.10 USD before tax, tariffs and shipping; prices recorded September 9, 2026
